faq.q: Do I have to cancel Lieferando or Wolt?
faq.a: No. Most businesses run both: the platform for new guests, your own system for everyone who comes back.

faq.q: How much does an ordering system cost?
faq.a: From €2,900 one-off to start, with online payment and kitchen display from €4,900. Operations from €49 per month.

faq.q: How fast can it go live?
faq.a: You'll see the clickable prototype after about seven days; most systems go live after three to four weeks.

faq.q: Can I change prices and items myself?
faq.a: Yes. You change prices, items, opening hours and sold-out status in the dashboard.

faq.q: Do you also shoot food photos and reels?
faq.a: Yes – that's where we come from. Food reels and photos are available on top of the system, so the menu actually sells.

cases.title: Six businesses, six bottlenecks.

why.title: Why the gap is so large
why.text: We develop with AI assistance and rely on proven building blocks for login, roles, uploads and notifications. You pay for your processes – not for someone reinventing the wheel.

items.title: Lettings without the enquiry flood
items.situation: Every listing brings 60 to 100 enquiries. Two staff members read, sort and phone around for appointments – actual advice gets squeezed out.

faq.q: Who is custom real estate software worth it for?
faq.a: As soon as a process repeats every week and no standard tool covers it properly. That is typically the case from around 30 units, from three to four staff, or with ongoing new-build projects. Below that, the Marketing package is often enough.

faq.q: Does this replace my property management software?
faq.a: No. We add the processes that are missing there and connect it via an interface or export where possible. Accounting and billing stay where they are.

faq.q: What does a tenant portal cost?
faq.a: A portal with login, documents, status and messages starts at around €7,400. With workflows, roles and approvals it is around €12,900. You get the fixed price after the prototype.

faq.q: How long does implementation take?
faq.a: You get the clickable prototype after 7 days. A marketing system is ready in three to four weeks, a portal in five to eight weeks. We go live with one property first and then roll out.

faq.q: Do tenants have to install an app?
faq.a: No. The portal runs in the browser on any phone, and sign-in works by link or code. Anyone who likes can add it to their home screen like an app.

faq.q: Can it connect to property portals and my software?
faq.a: Enquiries from the portals land in the same inbox as those from your website. For management software we use existing interfaces or exports. We clarify exactly what is possible in the process check – before you commission anything.

faq.q: Where is the data stored?
faq.a: In a database in the EU, encrypted, with roles, permissions and an audit log. Applicant documents are deleted automatically once the case is closed.

faq.q: What does ongoing operation cost?
faq.a: Hosting, updates and support start at €149 per month. Extensions are quoted at a fixed price each.

faq.q: Do you also make property videos?
faq.a: Yes. For premium properties we produce cinematic property films – one example is the AGILE film in the portfolio.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draft: Draft – describes the technical data flows of this website. Have it legally reviewed before going live.
privacy.formsText: When you contact us via the funnel or the pricing calculator, we store your details (name, email, optionally phone, company, message, selected services, budget range and calculation) to process your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The data is stored in a Supabase database (hosted in the EU, Frankfurt region) and processed via a self-hosted n8n workflow: a notification to us and a confirmation email to you. We only store your IP address as a salted hash to protect against spam. If no contract results, we delete enquiries after 24 months at the latest.
privacy.calendlyText: We only load the booking calendar after you click. Data is then transferred to Calendly LLC (USA) (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, EU-US Data Privacy Framework).
privacy.videosText: Preview clips are hosted on our own server. Links to YouTube only open in a new tab when you click them.
privacy.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection – a quick email to us is all it takes.
